name: Bootstrap Components
description: Lightweight Bootstrap 5 Single Directory Components (SDC) for theming.
project_description:
Bootstrap Components is a lean collection of production‑ready Bootstrap 5 Single Directory Components (SDC) for Drupal 10/11. 

 It delivers commonly used interface elements—buttons, modals, alerts, navigation, cards, carousel, accordions, pagination and more—in a clean, override‑friendly structure. 

 The emphasis is on clarity, accessibility, and easy extension: minimal glue code, modern Twig patterns, and attribute helpers so you can theme or swap variants without wrestling a large framework.
